summary.small_policy: 小規模の多少の退行は大規模で明確な改善があれば許容するという2026-10-23の指示に従う。
summary.comparison_scope: 同一main/共通I/O/SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS/コンパイラ設定で比較。mainはプロセス起動・入力・出力・破棄を含む。APIは構築後の照会ループ。baselineと同じcontrolを別バイナリとして回し、実行順を交替。時間の変動があるため個々の小差を一般的な高速化保証と解釈しない。

changes: 開始接頭辞の差deltaを事前計算し、両区間の一致判定を各長さ1回の乗算へ整理。差0では端点の直接比較。
非0差では先頭1文字の不一致と上限までの一致を先に判定。残る場合のみ二分探索。
128bit経路は乗算と端点差を積和にまとめて1回折り返し、pとの一致で剰余0を判定。標準C++代替経路の一致判定も維持。
本体の差分はlcp_uncheckedのみ。公開API・チェック・所有・構築・get・concat・copy/move等は変更なし。

static_review.scope: Independent static review of lcp arithmetic and early probes; no timing/builds by reviewer yet

arithmetic.notation: p=2^61-1; all stored prefixes/powers and normalized delta lie in [0,p)
arithmetic.native_raw: multiply_raw of canonical inputs is congruent to the product and lies in [0,2p)
arithmetic.portable_raw: multiply_raw of canonical inputs is congruent to the product and lies in [0,4p)
arithmetic.difference: D=end1+offset-raw-end2. offset=3p native or 5p portable. Therefore 0<D<4p native or 0<D<6p portable; each intermediate unsigned expression fits uint64_t and subtraction does not underflow
arithmetic.zero_test: For 0<D<6p, F=(D&p)+(D>>61) is congruent to D mod p and satisfies 0<F<p+6<2p. Thus F==p iff D is a positive multiple of p. D==0 is deliberately excluded by offsets
arithmetic.general_delta: delta=(left_start-right_start) mod p is normalized via start=left_start+p-right_start in [1,2p-1] and one subtraction. Using equal bases, left_end-delta*power-right_end is precisely the difference of the two substring hashes mod p
arithmetic.prefix_case: With l==0, left prefix hash is the stored left endpoint; right endpoint minus raw(right_start*power) minus left endpoint vanishes iff canonical hashes match

strategy.zero_limit: Returns before pointer arithmetic or memory access; moved/cleared objects remain safe
strategy.first_probe: A length-1 hash is the unsigned source byte, hence mismatch proves exact LCP=0 even with deliberately weak bases
strategy.full_probe: Equality returns the bound. Hash collisions can overestimate LCP, which is already documented
strategy.binary_interval: After first match and full mismatch, low=1 and high=limit-1. For limit=1 this branch is unreachable because first/full predicates are identical. For larger limits high is valid and no subtraction underflow occurs
strategy.collision_policy: Changing probe order can change false-positive results on crafted colliding inputs. Require direct_LCP<=returned<=bound and a matching hash at the returned length; require exact byte LCP when independent hashes show no post-mismatch prefix collision. Do not require old collision-specific LCP outputs

api_safety: Public range/base checks remain before lcp_unchecked, including zero-limit and empty cases
Bound=min(size-l,other.size-ol,limit) makes endpoint additions safe, including SIZE_MAX requested limit
For nonzero bound both owning vectors are nonempty and all selected prefix/power indices are in bounds
No ownership, allocation, copy/move, get, concat, or public equal behavior changes in either candidate
test_features: cpp_int independent prefix and substring hashes; exact equal comparisons for every inspected prefix
base2 61-byte constants 1,3,255 give exact zero residues; base p-2 alternating 1,2 gives cancellation
Nonzero unequal prefixes and starts exercise general delta extraction; unsigned-byte ordering exercised with 0/1/2/3/4/127/254/255 patterns
Zero/one/SIZE_MAX limits; lengths around 60/61/62 and 127/128; moved, cleared, empty suffix states
Checked-build invalid ranges and differing bases still throw even with zero limit

native_fused_proof.construction: Let x,power in [0,p), endpoint_a,endpoint_b in [0,p). correction=endpoint_a+p-endpoint_b lies in [1,2p-1]. product=x*power+correction is positive and <=(p-1)^2+2p-1=p^2<2^122, so uint128 multiplication/addition cannot overflow.
native_fused_proof.fold: 0<product<=p^2. Its folded low61+high61 representation is positive and <=2p-1. Therefore fold==p iff product is congruent to zero modulo p. Exact maximum p^2 folds to p and is accepted.
native_fused_proof.prefix_sign: product=right_start*power+left_end+p-right_end is the negative of the old difference mod p. Vanishing has the same equality meaning.
native_fused_proof.general_sign: delta=(left_start-right_start)modp. product=delta*power+right_end+p-left_end is the negative of substring hash difference mod p. Vanishing has the same equality meaning.
native_fused_proof.zero_start_fast_paths: When right_start==0 or normalized delta==0, multiplying it by any power contributes zero; the equality of canonical endpoints alone is both necessary and sufficient. This also covers distinct prefixes with colliding prefix hashes.
native_fused_proof.portable: Portable native-disabled branch remains the reviewed positive 5p-offset predicate and is unchanged mathematically.
native_fused_proof.preprocessor: offset is declared only when the portable predicate is compiled, so there is no native unused-offset declaration under -Werror.
native_fused_proof.maximum_fixture: With base=p-2, prefix bytes [1,1] hash to p-1 and power[61]=p-1. Let s=59 zero bytes followed by [1,1], so hash(s)=p-1. Let t=[1,1]+s, so hash(t)=0. The l=0,ol=2,length=61 predicate for s versus t computes exactly (p-1)^2+2p-1=p^2. Swapping to t.lcp(2,s,0,61) exercises the same p^2 bound through the general delta branch.

static_review.final_result: PASS independent static review; no builds or timings by reviewer

final_review.empty_safety: limit==0 returns before data().data()+l or powers access, preserving empty/cleared/moved safety.
final_review.normalized_delta: Each prefix in [0,p), so start=A+p-B in [1,2p-1]. The conditional subtraction normalizes to delta=(A-B)modp in [0,p).
final_review.unified_powers: Both objects have the same normalized base by public checks/precondition, so their canonical power values at each length agree. Using this->powers_ is valid because limit<=this->size()-l<=this->size().
final_review.delta_zero: If delta==0, equal endpoint hashes are equivalent to equal substring hashes. This remains true when different start prefixes happen to have colliding hashes. limit endpoint equality may return a collision overestimate, as documented.
final_review.delta_zero_search: After a full-length mismatch, true byte LCP<limit. low=0 is a matching empty prefix; high=limit-1 is valid even at limit=1, where the loop is skipped. Upper midpoint high-(high-low)/2 cannot overflow and, while low<high, always lies in [low+1,high].
final_review.nonzero_search: First-byte hash mismatch proves exact LCP=0 (source bytes in 0..255<p). If first byte matches and full length mismatches, limit>=2; therefore low=1<=high=limit-1. At limit=1 identical first/full predicates must have already returned. All later low values have actually matched hashes.
final_review.collision_guarantee: Let t be direct byte LCP capped by bound. Every predicate at length<=t is true, so no false branch can lower high below t. A successful full probe or later true collision can overestimate t but cannot underestimate it. The returned value is within [t,bound] and its substring hashes match. If independent hashes show no matching prefix beyond t, result equals t.
final_review.native_math: T=delta*power+(right_end+p-left_end) is positive and <=(p-1)^2+(2p-1)=p²<2^122. Fold(T) is positive and <2p; fold(T)==p iff T mod p==0. Congruence is the negative of substring-hash difference, so equality is exact at the hash level.
final_review.portable_raw_bound: Put q=2^61. a0,b0<2^32, a1,b1<2^29. low<2^64; cross=a0*b1+a1*b0<2^62, so cross>>29<2^33. Each masked shifted cross term and shifted high product is <q. The low folded term is at most p+7. Thus raw<3q+2^33+7<4p and all sums fit uint64_t. The formula is congruent to product because 2^61=1 and 2^64=8 mod p.
final_review.portable_zero_test: D=left_end+5p-raw-right_end satisfies 0<D<6p. Before subtraction left_end+5p<6p<2^64; each subtraction stays nonnegative. fold(D) is positive and <2p, so equality to p is equivalent to a zero difference mod p.
final_review.unchanged_areas: Byte-for-byte identity outside lcp_unchecked was checked against SHA494d baseline. Therefore public checks, ownership, constructor/assign loops, get/equal/concat, copy/move and exception guarantees remain unchanged.
final_review.compile_hygiene: No unused native-only offset remains; lambda is noexcept and public lcp_unchecked is noexcept; no extra guard or extension leaks into the standard fallback.
final_review.validation_status: Root is running final build/reference/sanitizer suites separately under locks. Reviewer did not build or time anything.

strategy.correctness_scope: Every candidate measured produced the same fixed-main output on all 29 official inputs; API harness checksums agree per condition. Root will run independent reference tests; these alone are not independent correctness proof.
strategy.selection_reason: First-byte/full-limit probes eliminate long searches for unrelated/equal ranges; canonical starting-prefix delta reduces general probes to one multiplication; zero delta compares endpoints directly; fused native predicate avoids canonicalization. Native unified fused candidate reduces code duplication and handles worst long-prefix offset cases faster than baseline.
caveats: Earlier isolated main screening and final screening have differing absolute times even though baseline .text matches. Use simultaneous rotated comparisons in final_main.json, not comparisons between batches.
Exponential probing rejected: long partial LCP up to 2.05 times baseline.
First/full probes alone rejected: long partial LCP about 1.07-1.24 times baseline at n131072.
Unfused unified path Clang l0/ol>0 longest partial prefix lcp ratio 1.013 in focused test; fused selected ratio .832.
Hash collisions remain possible as documented; exact probe decision tree may change collision-induced false answers.

arithmetic.scope: Temp-only RollingHash lcp equality arithmetic; no repo edits

proof.p: 2^61-1; stored prefix hashes and powers are canonical 0<=x<p
proof.portable_raw: Existing four-product raw is nonnegative and <4p
proof.unfused_prefix: D=rightEnd+k*p-raw(startOther,power)-leftEnd; k=3 native,5 standard. Strictly 0<D<(k+1)*p<=6p<2^64, no intermediate wrap. D congruent to right substring hash-left substring hash.
proof.unfused_general: delta=(startThis-startOther) mod p canonical. D=thisEnd+k*p-raw(delta,power)-otherEnd has same bounds and equals difference of canonical substring hashes modulo p. One multiplication instead of two.
proof.fold_test: For strictly positive D<6p<2^64, F=(D&p)+(D>>61) is positive and <2p; F==p iff D divisible byp. Thus equality needs no final canonical subtraction.
proof.zero: When cached startOther==0 or delta==0, multiplication is identically0 and canonical endpoint hashes can be compared directly. Empty limit must return0 before prefix reads, preserving moved/cleared objects.
proof.fused_native: product=start*power+(targetEnd+p-sourceEnd). Addedterm is in[1,2p-1], so1<=product<=(p-1)^2+2p-1=p²<2^122. One61bitfold is in[1,2p), equals p iff equality. Portable fallback preserves unfused predicate.
proof.collision_behavior: Arithmetic predicates are exactly equivalent to existing canonical get equality for every tested tuple, including collisions. Binary-search strategy unchanged in these candidates, so lcp returns exactly old values even for collision nonmonotonicity.

validation.unfused_initial_fix: Initial candidate lacked limit0guard and reference caught SIGSEGV on clearedempty. Fixedguard before allprefixreads; allreportedvalidation usescorrectedcandidate.

performance.recommendation: zero predicate is broadly better thanbaseline. Nativefused further helpsGCCrandomgeneraloffsets; Clanglongnonfullprefix regressesrelativezero by29%, so do not indiscriminately enablefused forClang. Strategyagent combiningearlyprobes; parent finalintegrationmeasurement decides.

rejected_candidates: 早期判定だけを追加すると長い非完全一致prefixで大規模LCP/compareが7〜24%遅い。
指数探索は長い非完全一致prefixで最大約2倍。
未融合の統合案はClangの長い非ゼロ差prefixで1.3%遅い条件があり、選定した融合案は同条件を改善。
